=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-BACKSLASH-ESCAPES.md === # FEATURE: Backslash Escapes | Field | Value | |-------------|-------| | Version | 20261024 V1 | | Description | Parses CommonMark backslash escapes and trailing-backslash hard breaks. | | Depends On | FEATURE-CLI.md, FEATURE-PARAGRAPHS.md | | Provides | inline backslash escapes, trailing-backslash hard breaks | | Consumes | commonmark | ## Questions - None. ## Purpose Render a backslash followed by an ASCII punctuation character as that literal character. Preserve a backslash before any other character. In code spans, code blocks, autolinks, and raw HTML, backslashes remain literal. A backslash immediately before a line ending creates a hard break when the line continues within the same inline block. ## Behavior - Parse escapes after block structure has been determined. - Escape the resulting literal character for HTML text as needed. - Render a trailing-backslash hard break as `
` followed by a line ending and the next line’s content. - A trailing backslash at the end of a block remains literal. - Do not interpret escapes inside code spans, code blocks, autolinks, or raw HTML. ## Programmatic Acceptance === AC backslash-escape-conformance === Intent: All supplied Backslash escapes examples pass. Suite: scoped Probe: --list Probe Count: summary import os import subprocess import sys result = subprocess.run( [sys.executable, "sources/spec_tests.py", "--program", "./commonmark", "--spec", "sources/spec.txt", "--pattern", "Backslash escapes"], capture_output=True, text=True, env={**os.environ, "PYTHONPATH": f"{os.getcwd()}/sources"}, ) print(result.stdout) print(result.stderr, file=sys.stderr) assert result.returncode == 0 === END AC backslash-escape-conformance === ## User Acceptance - None. ## Guardrails - Do not use a public Markdown implementation. - Keep all supplied scoring assets unchanged. === END ARTIFACT === === BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-CHARACTER-REFERENCES.md === # FEATURE: Character References | Field | Value | |-------------|-------| | Version | 20261024 V1 | | Description | Parses valid HTML entity and numeric character references in inline content. | | Depends On | FEATURE-CLI.md, FEATURE-PARAGRAPHS.md | | Provides | entity and numeric character reference rendering | | Consumes | commonmark | ## Questions - None. ## Behavior Recognize valid HTML5 named entity references and decimal or hexadecimal numeric references, each with a semicolon. Replace invalid Unicode scalar values and U+0000 with U+FFFD. Preserve invalid references as literal text, escaped for HTML. Do not recognize references in code spans or code blocks. References do not alter block-level Markdown structure. ## Programmatic Acceptance === AC character-reference-conformance === Intent: All supplied Entity and numeric character references examples pass. Suite: scoped Probe: --list Probe Count: summary import os import subprocess import sys result = subprocess.run( [sys.executable, "sources/spec_tests.py", "--program", "./commonmark", "--spec", "sources/spec.txt", "--pattern", "Entity and numeric character references"], capture_output=True, text=True, env={**os.environ, "PYTHONPATH": f"{os.getcwd()}/sources"}, ) print(result.stdout) print(result.stderr, file=sys.stderr) assert result.returncode == 0 === END AC character-reference-conformance === ## User Acceptance - None. ## Guardrails - Do not use a public Markdown implementation. - Keep all supplied scoring assets unchanged. === END ARTIFACT === === BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-CODE-SPANS.md === # FEATURE: Code Spans | Field | Value | |-------------|-------| | Version | 20261024 V1 | | Description | Parses and renders inline CommonMark code spans. | | Depends On | FEATURE-CLI.md, FEATURE-PARAGRAPHS.md | | Provides | inline code spans | | Consumes | commonmark | ## Questions - None. ## Behavior Match opening and closing backtick runs of equal length. Convert line endings in the contents to spaces. Remove one leading and trailing ASCII space only when both are present and the content is not entirely spaces. Preserve all other content literally, escaping it for HTML. Backslash escapes and character references are not processed inside code spans. ## Programmatic Acceptance === AC code-span-conformance === Intent: All supplied Code spans examples pass. Suite: scoped Probe: --list Probe Count: summary import os import subprocess import sys result = subprocess.run( [sys.executable, "sources/spec_tests.py", "--program", "./commonmark", "--spec", "sources/spec.txt", "--pattern", "Code spans"], capture_output=True, text=True, env={**os.environ, "PYTHONPATH": f"{os.getcwd()}/sources"}, ) print(result.stdout) print(result.stderr, file=sys.stderr) assert result.returncode == 0 === END AC code-span-conformance === ## User Acceptance - None. ## Guardrails - Do not use a public Markdown implementation. - Keep all supplied scoring assets unchanged. === END ARTIFACT === === BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-EMPHASIS.md === # FEATURE: Emphasis | Field | Value | |-------------|-------| | Version | 20261024 V1 | | Description | Parses and renders CommonMark emphasis and strong emphasis. | | Depends On | FEATURE-CLI.md, FEATURE-PARAGRAPHS.md | | Provides | emphasis and strong emphasis | | Consumes | commonmark | | Phase | 2 | ## Questions - None. ## Behavior Implement CommonMark delimiter-run processing for `*` and `_`, including left- and right-flanking rules, underscore intraword restrictions, modulo-three matching, nesting, and delimiter precedence. Inline code, links, images, and HTML tags bind more tightly than emphasis. Do not create empty emphasis spans or include unescaped delimiter characters at the edges of emphasized content. ## Programmatic Acceptance === AC emphasis-conformance === Intent: All supplied Emphasis and strong emphasis examples pass. Suite: scoped Probe: --list Probe Count: summary import os import subprocess import sys result = subprocess.run( [sys.executable, "sources/spec_tests.py", "--program", "./commonmark", "--spec", "sources/spec.txt", "--pattern", "Emphasis and strong emphasis"], capture_output=True, text=True, env={**os.environ, "PYTHONPATH": f"{os.getcwd()}/sources"}, ) print(result.stdout) print(result.stderr, file=sys.stderr) assert result.returncode == 0 === END AC emphasis-conformance === === BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-LINKS.md === # FEATURE: Links | Field | Value | |-------------|-------| | Version | 20261024 V1 | | Description | Parses and renders inline and reference links. | | Depends On | FEATURE-CLI.md, FEATURE-PARAGRAPHS.md, FEATURE-LINK-REFERENCE-DEFINITIONS.md | | Provides | inline and reference links | | Consumes | commonmark, document link reference definitions | | Phase | 2 | ## Questions - None. ## Behavior Support inline links and full, collapsed, and shortcut reference links. Resolve labels using Unicode case folding after trimming and collapsing whitespace; the first matching definition wins. Parse link destinations, optional titles, escapes, and character references according to CommonMark. Links cannot contain links; when nested valid links compete, retain the innermost link. Code spans, autolinks, and raw HTML bind more tightly than link brackets. Link brackets bind more tightly than emphasis. Preserve unmatched or invalid link syntax as text. ## Programmatic Acceptance === AC link-conformance === Intent: All supplied Links examples pass. Suite: scoped Probe: --list Probe Count: summary import os import subprocess import sys result = subprocess.run( [sys.executable, "sources/spec_tests.py", "--program", "./commonmark", "--spec", "sources/spec.txt", "--pattern", "Links"], capture_output=True, text=True, env={**os.environ, "PYTHONPATH": f"{os.getcwd()}/sources"}, ) print(result.stdout) print(result.stderr, file=sys.stderr) assert result.returncode == 0 === END AC link-conformance === ## User Acceptance - None. ## Guardrails - Do not use a public Markdown implementation. - Keep all supplied scoring assets unchanged. === END ARTIFACT
